svg.text: state and rules are code: persistent, exact, inspectable
Every entity is typed and tagged, so rules address classes, not instances:
Play: rules run the world; the AI only patches gaps
take · put · interact → rule library → hit: execute | miss: just-in-time mod
Rule library (shared by all players · versioned)
② re-resolves and now hits the patch: the slime is oiled, and any later fire ignites it —
for every instance of these types, for every player, with no further AI calls.
Why code, not a world model
• state lives in pixels: drifts, forgets
• code runs every frame; AI only on novelty
